Current TikTok product/order collection is **header/list grain**, not SKU grain.

| `sku_name` | **No** | Nowhere in scraper / converter / ingest / DB. |

| Multi-SKU order lines | **No** | 1 row per `order_id`. 005 explicitly defers `fact_tiktok_order_line`. |

### Orders path

- Scraper: `E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）\collectors\tiktok-ads\scripts\scrape-orders-page.js`

- `sellerSku` / `skuId` always `""`
- `productName` almost always `"1 件商品"` / `"N 件商品"` (list page has no real title/SKU)

### Products / inventory path
